title: fix(plugin-charts): read a chart's object metadata through the data source's shared read (objectui#13039)
body:
Fixes #13039
Clause-②: no

## What changed

`ObjectChart`'s category option-colour / dimension-label effect read `/api/v1/meta/object/NAME` with its own raw `fetch`, outside the data layer's request-key cache. Every object-bound chart therefore sent one request of its own, beside the cached `getObjectSchema` read that the same chart's group-by label leg, the metric tile and the data table already make.

The effect now reads through the data source's `getObjectSchema` whenever a data source that answers it is in scope (the `dataSource` prop, else the `SchemaRendererContext` one). The ObjectStack adapter's `MetadataCache.get` joins concurrent reads of one name, so N charts and tiles over one object make one `meta/object/NAME` request.

- **Shape.** The data source answers the bare object document. The raw leg's unwrap (`item`, else `data`, else the body) yields the same document, so `loadDimensionFieldMeta` gets one shape from either leg. No change to category or option resolution, dotted dimension paths included.
- **Where the raw read stays (the fallback).** In the same effect, in `loadObjectSchema`: when no data source is in scope, or the one in scope has no `getObjectSchema` (a host stub, a standalone embed). The dataset definition read (`/api/v1/meta/dataset/NAME`) is unchanged and stays raw.
- `dataSource` joins the effect's dependency list, beside `apiFetch`.

No export, prop or type member is added.

## The dataset route: `useDatasetDimensionMeta` (round 2, seat ruling `6267898178`)

The card measured HotCRM's sales dashboard, where every widget is **dataset-bound** (`dataset: 'opportunity_metrics'`). Those widgets render through `plugin-dashboard`'s `DatasetWidget`, which reads object metadata through `useDatasetDimensionMeta` in `@object-ui/react` (`packages/react/src/hooks/useDatasetDimensionLabels.ts`). That hook made its own raw `fetch` of `/api/v1/meta/object/NAME`, one per non-metric widget.

The hook now reads through `SchemaRendererContext`'s `dataSource.getObjectSchema` when the context's data source answers it. The raw fetch stays as the fallback, in that hook's `loadObjectSchema`, when there is no such source. `dataSource` joins the effect's dependencies. `ConsoleShell` mounts `SchemaRendererProvider` with the adapter, so in the console the dataset widgets of one dashboard share one read. `plugin-report`'s `useDatasetDimensionLabels.ts` only re-exports the hook and is untouched.

**The seat widened the file surface** to this hook by ruling `6267898178` (the claim `6267319279`, amended in place).

## Pins

New, `packages/plugin-charts/src/ObjectChart.sharedSchemaRead-13039.test.tsx` and `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/sharedObjectSchemaRead-13039.test.tsx`. The test data source joins concurrent reads of one name, as `MetadataCache.get` does. Each pin counts what that source sent plus every `/meta/object/` URL that reached the global `fetch`. The raw route answers the same documents, so a pin can go red only on which route carried the read.

- (a) three `ObjectChart`s over one object make one request;
- (b) `ObjectChart` plus `ObjectMetricWidget` over one object make one request;
- (c) CONTROL: two objects make one request each;
- (c) CONTROL: a chart with no data source resolves its colours through the raw fallback;
- (c) CONTROL: a dotted dataset dimension (`account.industry`) still walks to the owning object, both reads shared.

**Ablation**, run after the fix was committed (`b7c83e1a97`), through `ablation-replace.mjs` with the `loadObjectSchema` condition replaced by `false` (the raw read restored). The anchor went from 1 to 0 and the blob from `bb784a014b97` to `cdfcc66cf48a`. Result: (a), (b), the two-object control and the dotted control went red on the route count (`expected [ …(3) ] to deeply equal []`). The no-data-source control stayed green, as expected. After the restore, the blob is back to `bb784a014b97` == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

**Changed existing pin:** `ObjectChart.fieldOptionLabelRefetch.test.tsx` (the no-refetch-loop pin). Its data source counts `getObjectSchema` calls without joining them, so one data load now reads 2 (the option-colour effect and the group-by label leg), constant across re-renders. The pin asserts that 2, named, in place of 1.

**Round-2 pins:**
- `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DatasetWidget.sharedSchemaRead-13039.test.tsx`: three `DatasetWidget`s over one object make one request.
- Its controls: two objects make two requests; with no context source the raw fallback still relabels; labels are unchanged.
- Ablation at `07a99a7226`: blob `417fdeb4284a` → `2b2a860e0931`. The one-object pin and the two-object control went red. Restored to `417fdeb4284a` == HEAD.

**Changed existing pin:** `DatasetWidget.starvationFingerprints-7696.test.tsx`. Its context source now answers `queryDataset` only, so the file keeps measuring the raw route the objectui#7696 report rode. The widget still takes the full source through its prop.

**Round-2 verification at `b8714c36c8`:**

- Reader run, 33 files: green after the fingerprint fixture fix.
